the deconfinement temperature of a string with massive ends (Nambu-Gotos) does not depend either on the value of the masses of the ends (quarks), nor on the string tension.
the Nambu–Goto string connecting massive point-like quarks has the same critical (or de-confinement) temperature as the Nambu – Goto string with fixed ends.

the critical temperature for a string connecting point-like massive quarks does not depend on quark mass and coincides with the critical temperature for the string connecting infinitely heavy immobile quark.
